title: fix(console): the publish-health line shows a finding's customer sentence and folds agent text under technical details
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4KthxjbE68SmtZYZQBCfuQ)_

Part of #32984 — the console read of ruling 6929121584 (Q1 letter B, parameter 4). The producer side that writes `probes.issues[].userMessage` is a separate PR on `claude/issue-32984-build-finding-user-message`. This PR reads the field tolerantly, so it needs nothing from that PR to land.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 搭建对话里，发布后的健康提示行不再原样显示写给 AI 的英文检查结果。某条结果带有客户句（`userMessage`）时，提示行显示这句话。没带时，显示搭建卡已在用的通用提示句（「这次搭建有部分内容需要修复后才能使用……」）。原始的检查文字统一折叠到「技术详情」里。示例数据加载失败也改用语言包里的句子（「示例数据未能加载。」）。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决 B「出问题的一方写客户句」，界面不再自己维护按错误码翻译的表。
- 风险与回滚：只改这一行的显示方式，以及 `publishHealthFromResponse` 读出的字段（新增三个可选字段）。`seedError` 现在只放服务端自己给的文字，不再自己编一句英文。回滚：revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 的 `PublishHealthLine`，`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/publishHealth.ts`，`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` 的 `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.needsAttention-32984.test.tsx`，预期 13 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `publishHealth.ts`: `PublishHealth.issues[]` gains optional `userMessage` and `fix`. Each is read only when it is a non-empty string. `PublishHealth.seedFailed` (optional) marks a failed seed load. `seedError` now holds only the producer's own text, and is absent when the producer sent none. The English 'Sample data failed to load.' the reader used to make up is gone. A seed-loader finding object in `seedApplied.errors[]` now gives its `message`. Before, `String()` turned it into `[object Object]`.
- `PublishHealthLine`: a finding with a `userMessage` shows that sentence on the line. Findings without one get a single generic sentence, the same one the draft-issues block uses (`chatbot.build.issuesSummary` when an error is in the set, else `chatbot.build.warningsSummary`). Every finding's `message` (plus its `fix`) and the seed loader's text go under a closed "Technical details" (`chatbot.build.issuesDetails`). A failed seed reads `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed`.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: one new key, `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed`, in all eleven packs. zh-Hant is generated by `gen:zh-hant`. The existing keys are reused because they fit.
- Seed text: `seedApplied.error` carries engine text (for example `seed apply stopped at the seed for object 'x': …`, or `seed apply: no readable seed bodies`), not a customer sentence. So the line always shows the localized seed sentence, and that text appears only under the details.

## Tests

- New `describe` in `ChatbotEnhanced.needsAttention-32984.test.tsx` (the shared I18nProvider harness), 6 cases: a finding with a `userMessage` (the sentence is shown, and the agent text and fix appear only in the closed details); one without (zh-Hans generic sentence, agent text only under the details); warnings only; a mixed set; a failed seed in `ja` with loader text kept as a detail; a failed seed with no producer text (zh-Hans sentence, no English, no details).
- `ChatbotEnhanced.test.tsx`: the existing health cases now assert the new faces. Two new `publishHealthFromResponse` cases cover non-empty-string reads, a loader finding object, and no invented text.

## Acceptance notes

- `usePublishAllDrafts` and `PendingDraftsBar` (app-shell, outside this claim's file surface) still read `seedError` as the failure flag and print it in toasts. When a seed fails with no producer text, they now get nothing. No in-repo producer sends that case: every `success: false` from the three seed producers carries `error` or a non-empty `errors[]` (`applyPublishedSeeds`, `applySeedBodies` and the catch around each). Their toasts still print engine text verbatim, which is the same class of problem this PR fixes on the line.

## Verification

<details><summary>Readings (head 92fc05bc9)</summary>

- Build closure `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-chatbot^...' --concurrency=2` under os-verify-lock: 49/49 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/i18n/`: Test Files 203 passed (203), Tests 2912 passed, 13 skipped. Then `type-check` for plugin-chatbot (both tsc programs, test layer included) and i18n. VERDICT command-exit 0 for the chain.
- Ablation 1 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): voice every finding with `userMessage ?? message`. 3 failed, 10 passed. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Ablation 2: the seed line prints `seedError ?? 'Sample data failed to load.'`. 2 failed, 11 passed. Restored the same way.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 41): the unlocked node and `check:*` set ran, with exit codes captured before any pipe. Results are in the os-dev-report on #32984. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (the i18n key gates) is NOT MEASURED locally (wind-down) and is left to Test UI in CI.

</details>
